name: com.unity.building-blocks.touch-input
description: Mobile touch input building blocks: composable on-screen controls (joysticks and buttons) built on a UI-agnostic core, a uGUI presentation layer, an optional Input System device (<TouchRig>) with rig-side action mappings and editor authoring tools, runtime tuning, rebinding and mapping that can be saved, per-platform Show on, and optional Pipeline CLI commands. Early preview.
